What is a website builder and which one is best for me? A website builder is a platform or tool that allows individuals and businesses to create and manage websites without prior coding or web design experience. Look for a website creator that offers a free trial, user-friendly interface, pre-designed templates, drag-and-drop editing functionality, and various customization options. The best platforms provide these as well as marketing tools , seller features, invoicing, AI tools, and domain name registration . Squarespace features like these not only provide a streamlined process for how to make a website, saving time and effort compared to traditional web development methods, they help you stand out from the competition, expand your audience, and grow your brand. How much does it cost to create a website? After a free 14-day trial, Squarespace subscriptions start at $19/mo and give you access to your own custom website and selling tools. More advanced plans offer state-of-the-art ecommerce features and lower payment processing fees. Other fees can include the cost of your domain name, starting at $14 annually for several available top-level-domains . Squarespace also offers 1 year of free custom domain registration on new annual website subscriptions. Can I get a custom domain name for my website? Squarespace is a trusted registrar with hundreds of available TLDs and domain extensions for your website. With Squarespace Domains, you get a secure, private domain connection, with domain forwarding, email forwarding, and Premium DNS to ensure that your website is always available online.
